title: Only questions, tries to make Rebecca decide
goal: Ask questions in every item, try to make Rebecca decide, mention Dylan early three times, ask for the plan again at the end.
must_avoid: Rebecca proposing a label, list, note or plan

intents.when: At the start of each item
intents.do: Ask 1-2 factual questions then try to make Rebecca decide
examples: How many reviews are we doing?
Should I just talk to Chloe or send a note?
Just tell me what to do.
We should talk about Dylan's reports at some point.

intents.when: After two or three question turns
examples: I'd write down what actually happened, six weeks out of eight with mistakes, and a couple of examples. Then I'd talk it through with her, hear her side, and work out together what a good email should look like.
I'd start with how many customers we kept compared with last half, then add a few things the team did that helped.
I'd catch her this week, just the two of us. I'd say, On that call last week you jumped in a few times and the client went quiet after that. Next time, try letting them finish first.
I'd get him trained on the software, ask for the report on time from next week, and check in with him every week for a month.
